prompt: Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic outbreak-horror sequence taking place entirely inside a modern Korean corporate office, using the uploaded image as the highest-priority reference for the female lead and preserving her exact face, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions and outfit. The young Korean woman works alone at her desk late at night when a strange coworker suddenly appears between the cubicles, breathing heavily and moving unnaturally. He collapses beside a workstation, convulses violently, then suddenly rises with bloodshot eyes and charges at another employee. The office erupts into panic as employees sprint between desks, knocking over chairs, monitors and papers. The woman runs toward the main entrance but sees infected coworkers flooding the hallway, forcing her to turn back. She and several survivors push desks, chairs and filing cabinets against the glass entrance doors as infected employees violently pound against them. Cracks spread across the glass before one panel suddenly shatters and infected hands reach through the opening. The survivors retreat deeper into the office and rush into a glass conference room, slamming the door behind them. They drag a large conference table against the entrance while the infected swarm surrounds the room. The woman notices a trapped coworker outside, briefly opens the door, pulls him inside and immediately barricades it again. Everyone falls silent, breathing heavily as infected silhouettes pound against the cracked glass. The office lights suddenly shut off, leaving only red emergency lighting as the glass begins to fracture under the pressure. translations.zh: 制作一段30秒、1080p的超写实丧尸爆发恐怖片段，地点位于现代韩国企业办公室内。以上传图像为女主角最高优先级参考，保留其面部、发型、肤色、身材与服装。年轻韩国女子深夜独坐办公，一名怪异同事出现并抽搐暴起袭击他人。办公室陷入恐慌，员工四处奔逃。女子与幸存者用桌椅封堵玻璃大门，玻璃碎裂后众人退守玻璃会议室，合力拉动会议桌堵门，并救进一名受困同事。灯光熄灭转为红色应急灯，玻璃逐渐碎裂，最终以女子在感染者包围中惊恐注视镜头结束，切黑。写实韩国办公环境、手持摄影、应急红光、喘息及撞门声等。
